definitions.explanation: The act of restraining, subduing, or keeping something down by force. Used for political oppression, psychological repression, or forceful control.

examples.japanese: {感情|かんじょう}を{抑圧|よくあつ}する
その{政権|せいけん}は{反対派|はんたいは}を{抑圧|よくあつ}した。
{長年|ながねん}{抑圧|よくあつ}されてきた{記憶|きおく}が、{突然|とつぜん}{蘇|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: Memories that had been repressed for years suddenly resurfaced.

notes:
USAGE: {抑圧|よくあつ} has both political/social and psychological meanings. In psychology, it refers to the unconscious pushing down of unacceptable thoughts or memories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感情|かんじょう}/{欲望|よくぼう}を{抑圧|よくあつ}する (to repress emotions/desires)
- {抑圧|よくあつ}された{記憶|きおく} (repressed memories)
- {抑圧|よくあつ}からの{解放|かいほう} (liberation from oppression)
- {自由|じゆう}の{抑圧|よくあつ} (suppression of freedom)

RELATED WORDS:
- {圧迫|あっぱく} (pressure, oppression - more physical)
- {弾圧|だんあつ} (suppression, crackdown - political)
- {抑制|よくせい} (restraint, control - less forceful)
